text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for inviting me out today! I've been looking forward to this outing together♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は誘ってくれてありがとう！
あなたと一緒にお出かけできるの、
楽しみにしてたんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, having someone celebrate it with me like this really does make me happy! Living alone like I am, it also makes me glad I won't spend a lonely birthday~
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
こうしてお祝いしてもらえると、
やっぱりうれしいな！
今は一人暮らしだし、
さびしいお誕生日にならなくてよかったよ～

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: But I guess I didn't expect it to be just the two of us...? Everyone in class was saying things like, "You two have fun together, okay?" Geez... they didn't have to go out of their way to be so considerate towards me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
二人きりなのは、
ちょっと予想外だったかも……？
クラスのみんなは、
二人で仲良くね～
とか言ってたし。
も
う、
そんなに気を遣わなくたっていいのになぁ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's nothing, just talking to myself! So, where are we going today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
なんでもないよっ、
こっちの話！
それで、
今日はどこへ行く予定なの？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Adventure... do you mean in the game, together? ...That's not it, you mean in "this" world?
text_block_list.orig_text:
冒険って、
一緒にゲームを遊ぶってこと？
……
そうじゃなくて、
こっちの世界で？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: I see, I get it... So it's less like a simple outing and more like a little trip? I like that! That sounds really fun♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
そっか……
お出かけっていうより、
ちょっとした
旅みたいな気分？
いいね、
それ！　
すっごく面白そうっ♪

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Since coming here, we've gone out to lots of places together... but there are still so many places I've never seen. Just thinking about a new adventure makes me excited!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちに来てから、
みんなでいろんなところにお出かけしたけど……
知らない場所もまだたくさんあるもんね。
新しい冒険、
考えるだけでワクワクしちゃうっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Alright, that settles it. Your present is an amazing adventure trip! Yeah, I love it! As for our destination...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ～し、
決まりだねっ。
プレゼントはとびっきりの冒険旅行！　
うん、
素敵だね！
目的地は、
そうだなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That sounds nice! That's one of my favorite views... it's the best birthday present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！　
それ、
すごくいいねっ！
私の大好きな景色……
一番の誕生日プレゼントだよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Now, let's go! To search for a blue sky the two of us will remember for the rest of our lives!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！　
それじゃあ
出発だよっ！
一生の思い出になるような青空、
二人で一緒に探しに行こうっ！
